Implemented at dae45f338 on branch claude/evidence-binding-s0 (stacked on unlanded candidate 629c811ab; branch also fetched into primary). Python tools only; no Scala types changed, so no sbt gate or sibling seam.
Guard: attribution needs a cited record overlapping a target interval (same part clock, half-open), or a cited same_situation path to one (identity mode: same_entity path from an argument). Anchors derived from record timing. Unbound proofs keep localStatus; status Unresolved + reference_unresolved + targetUnbound. Unbound counter no longer contradicts; parent joins use attributed proofs only. Empty or malformed target refused. Prompt states the rule.
Evidence: unittest discover in tools 163 passed / 0 failed (155 at parent). 8 new TargetBindingTests. 6 compiled mutants (bound-always, no-continuity-path, closed-overlap, ignore-part, accept-empty-target, counter-unfiltered) each fail the named test with ConnectedTests passing.
Offline re-validation of frozen connected-main-03 (no model calls, references unchanged): only context_human body changes; 5 components Supported->Unresolved (d526-floor c1-c4; d93-coat-collar c1, which cites 158-162 s annotations for a 152-155 s target with no continuity path). Body context correct 18->13; all other conditions unchanged; wrong unchanged; no refusals. Evidence in .agent-work/evidence-binding-s0-evidence/{rescore.py,rescore.json,tests-all.log} (ignored, local).
Independent cold review requested on the exact SHA.
